Definition: Whether the system enables individuals to authenticate themselves or their documents digitally through electronic verification
Comments: The NUI biometric system is designed to enable authentication for public and private sector services. IriTech IriAegis-BK supports authentication via iris biometrics. DPI Map (Oct 2024): 'Enables authentication: NA'. System in pilot phase, not yet operationally deployed for authentication.

Definition: Whether authentication is possible through a centralized government portal or digital gateway
Comments: PRODIGY aims to build digital government services portal (digital.gov.mg). DPI Map (Oct 2024): 'Enables authentication via government portal: NA'. Portal authentication functionality planned but not yet operational.

Definition: Whether individuals can view their data held in the ID database and see how it has been accessed
Comments: Law No. 2014-038 grants individuals the right to access their personal data. However, DPI Map notes 'Data handling terms exist: NO'. CMIL not yet fully operational to enforce this right. No self-service portal for individual data access has been documented.

Definition: Whether the system enables Know Your Customer (KYC) packet collection for service provision, particularly financial services
Comments: DPI Map (Oct 2024): 'Enables KYC: NA'. The CIN is the primary KYC document for financial services (SmileID). New NUI system aims to enable electronic KYC but not yet operational nationally. AML/KYC Law n°2018-043 applies.

Definition: Whether the ID authority and system are subject to general oversight of the courts and judicial review
Comments: Local trial courts (Tribunaux de Premier Instance) store duplicate civil registration books and adjudicate late birth registrations and disputes. No specific judicial oversight mechanism for the digital ID system has been documented.

Definition: Whether procedural rules for collection, storage, and sharing of ID-related personal data are publicly available and established
Comments: DPI Map (Oct 2024) confirms 'Terms of data storage and sharing available: NO' and 'Data handling terms exist: NO'. Law No. 2014-038 contains general data transfer provisions but no formal inter-agency data sharing rules for the ID system have been published.

Definition: Whether national data protection legislation exists and covers personal data linked to the ID system
Comments: Law No. 2014-038 on Protection of Personal Data adopted December 2014, promulgated January 2015. Application not yet effective as no implementing decree published. Madagascar also ratified the Malabo Convention in June 2024. CMIL established December 2023 but not yet fully operational.

Definition: Whether a Data Protection Authority or similar body regulates ID data collection and sharing by the ID system
Comments: CMIL (Commission Malagasy sur l'Informatique et des Libertés) established by Decree No. 2023-1541 dated 6 December 2023. Partially constituted but not fully operational as of 2025 (some member appointments pending).

Definition: Whether the ongoing management, maintenance and development of the ID system can be funded by sustainable domestic resources
Comments: PRODIGY is primarily funded by World Bank IDA ($140M credit + $3M GFF grant). Project extended to June 2026 due to implementation delays. Long-term government sustainability post-WB funding is uncertain. Government preference for national procurement methods noted.

Definition: Whether the digital ID system is designed to be interoperable across government agencies and with other systems through APIs or data exchange protocols
Comments: Digital Governance Unit (UGD/MNDPT) is working to ensure interoperability between Justice, Civil Registry, and other public services under PRODIGY. Interoperability platform under development, not yet fully operational.

Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for accessing public healthcare services
Comments: PRODIGY includes health sector integration for vital event registration. World Bank press release states project will 'strengthen the role of the health sector to contribute to timely registration of vital events'. Maternity wards being equipped with connected tablets. Full health service ID linkage not yet operational.

Definition: Whether non-nationals including refugees, asylum seekers, and permanent residents are eligible to register
Comments: The CIN (Carte d'Identité Nationale) is for Malagasy citizens only. Foreigners residing legally can obtain a separate 'resident card' through the Immigration Services. No evidence of refugee ID provisions under the new NUI system.

Definition: Percentage of eligible population that has been issued or registered with digital ID credentials
Comments: New NUI biometric system targets 2 million enrollments (urban areas) by June 2026 and ~8M rural later in 2026, out of 12M+ target population (18+). Total population ~29M. Birth registration rate decreased from 80% (2009) to 74% (2021). Current digital ID coverage is below 20%.

Definition: Whether ID system undergoes regular security audits, penetration testing, or vulnerability assessments
Comments: World Bank PRODIGY project appraisal references a planned security audit of key government digital systems with an independent firm producing the final audit report (PBC 4.4). Procurement of data security and privacy software/hardware planned under extended PRODIGY timeline.
